anchors.reading_rule: Arrow direction: 0 north, 1 east, 2 south, 3 west; ? if between directions. Fictional rule, not entropy evidence.
Slider position: 0 lower stop, 1 upper stop; ? if between stops.
Read the ring notch index 0..7 against the fixed zero mark; ? if unaligned.
Count beads in the marked lane, 0..15; - if the lane cannot be read.
Read the pointer quadrant 0..3 clockwise from the fixed zero mark; ? at a boundary.
Read the lever detent index 0..5; ? between detents; - if absent.
